description.zh: 动态路由的应用ID集合。最多可输入200个内网访问应用ID。当**ApplicationType**为**Application**时，必填。和**TagIds**二选一。当**ApplicationType**为**All**时，禁止输入。
description.en: A collection of private network access application IDs for the dynamic route. You can specify up to 200 IDs. This parameter is required when **ApplicationType** is set to **Application**. Specify either this parameter or **TagIds**, but not both. Do not specify this parameter when **ApplicationType** is set to **All**.

description.zh:
动态路由的应用类型。取值：
- **All**：全部应用。
- **Application**：应用。
- **Tag**：标签。
description.en:
The application type of the dynamic route. Valid values:

- **All**: All applications.

- **Application**: Application.

- **Tag**: Tag.

description.zh: 动态路由描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格。
description.en: The description of the dynamic route. The description must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces.
The ID of the dynamic route.

description.zh: 动态路由类型。取值：**connector**：自由专线。
description.en: The type of the dynamic route. Valid value: **connector**: leased line.

description.zh:
动态路由的修改类型。取值：
- **Cover**（默认）：使用**RegionIds**、**ApplicationIds**、**TagIds**、参数的值覆盖原SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域、内网访问应用ID集合、内网访问标签集合。
- **Append**：在原SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域、内网访问应用ID集合、内网访问标签集合中分别增加**RegionIds**、**ApplicationIds**、**TagIds**参数中输入的值。
description.en:
The modification type of the dynamic route. Valid values:

- **Cover** (default): Use the values of **RegionIds**, **ApplicationIds**, and **TagIds** to overwrite the existing regions, private network access application IDs, and private network access tag IDs supported by the SASE POP cluster access points.

- **Append**: Add the values specified in **RegionIds**, **ApplicationIds**, and **TagIds** to the existing regions, private network access application IDs, and private network access tag IDs supported by the SASE POP cluster access points.

description.zh: 动态路由名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the dynamic route. The name must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
动态路由下一跳实例ID。取值来源：
 - [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~)：批量查询Connector。
description.en:
The next hop instance ID of the dynamic route. To get valid values, see:

- [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~): Query connectors in bulk.

description.zh: 动态路由优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1-99。
description.en: The route priority. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority. Valid values: 1 to 99.

description.zh: SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域列表。
description.en: A list of regions supported by the SASE POP cluster access points.

description.zh:
动态路由状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the dynamic route. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enable the route.

- **Disabled**: Disable the route.

description.zh: 动态路由的内网访问标签ID集合。最多可输入40个内网访问标签ID。当**ApplicationType**为**Tag**时，必填。和**ApplicationIds**二选一。当**ApplicationType**为**All**时，禁止输入。
description.en: A collection of private network access tag IDs for the dynamic route. You can specify up to 40 IDs. This parameter is required when **ApplicationType** is set to **Tag**. Specify either this parameter or **ApplicationIds**, but not both. Do not specify this parameter when **ApplicationType** is set to **All**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas update-dynamic-route --dynamic-route-id dr-ca9fddfac7c60000 --name dynamic_route_name --description '这是一条动态路由' --status Disabled --priority 99 --region-ids ap-southeast-1 --application-type Application --application-ids pa-application-f4dd77bced900000 --tag-ids tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --dynamic-route-type connector --next-hop connector-8ccb13b6f52c0000 --modify-type Cover --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas UpdateDynamicRoute --region cn-hangzhou --Status Disabled --ApplicationType Application --ModifyType Cover --Description '这是一条动态路由' --Priority 99 --NextHop 'connector-8ccb13b6f52c0000' --TagIds.1 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --ApplicationIds.1 'pa-application-f4dd77bced900000' --DynamicRouteId 'dr-ca9fddfac7c60000' --DynamicRouteType connector --RegionIds.1 'ap-southeast-1' --Name dynamic_route_name --method POST --force
